checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Amber glass hand soap bottle is main subject
must.why: Centered amber bottle with black pump.
Cream label wraps the bottle's middle.

must.item: Label reads exactly VELORA in clear uppercase
must.why: Reads VELORA in dark serif caps.
Text is centered on the label with good margins.

must.item: Brand name unobscured and readable at 640px
must.why: Dark text on cream, clearly legible.

faults.what: The label is flat and does not curve with the bottle, so it looks slightly pasted on.
The image is only 640px, which is low resolution.

summary: A clean, well-lit amber pump bottle with a cream label that reads VELORA correctly; the only flaws are the flat label and the low resolution.
